chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abī ʿAbdِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام that he said:
If a man catches one takbīrah or two takbīrahs of the prayer over the deceased, then let him complete what remains consecutively.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرَةَ: a single takbir in the funeral prayer
key_terms.التَّكْبِيرَتَيْنِ: two takbirs already caught in the funeral prayer
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ: the funeral prayer performed over the deceased
key_terms.فَلْيَقْضِ: let him complete or make up what remains

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he joins the funeral prayer after missing some takbirs?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about joining salat over the deceased after it has already begun. If someone catches only one or two takbirs, he should make up the remaining takbirs in immediate succession.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.471 - Al-Halabi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:
"If a person catches one or two takbirs of the funeral prayer over the deceased, they should complete the remaining takbirs consecutively."
